title: Walsh character under matrix multiplication
statement: Let $m,n$ be natural numbers, let $H$ be an $m$-by-$n$ matrix over $\mathbb F_2$, let $\gamma\in\mathbb F_2^n$, and let $y\in\mathbb F_2^m$. The Walsh character indexed by $\gamma$, evaluated at the row-vector product $yH$, equals the Walsh character indexed by the column-vector product $H\gamma$, evaluated at $y$.
